<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395. Assuming this is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈ 234.132 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 16 % M+1 and ≈ 4–5 % M+2) suggests about 15 carbon atoms and the presence of one sulfur atom. A formula that matches the exact mass and isotopic distribution is C₁₄H₁₈OS, whose calculated neutral mass is 234.1078 Da and [M+H]⁺ = 235.1151 Da, within experimental error. Therefore the molecular formula in the required format is C14H18O1S.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O1S</final_answer>
